title: Dashing In! Here to Save the Day!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... hup!
All right, that's the last of 'em!

While taking inventory in the storehouse,
Biko Pegasus showed up.
She was carrying huge packages with her
small body...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Hehe...
I was on my justice patrol when I heard
someone calling for a hero!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I was having trouble carrying them all by
myself,
but Biko-san stepped in to lend a hand...
It was a huge help, really!

It looks like Biko Pegasus is patrolling
around Tracen Academy.
I wonder if there's anything I can help
with...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You wanna come too?! Woohoo! With you around,
Trainer, we'll be an unstoppable duo!
Let's protect the peace of Tracen Academy
together!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! Pegasus Hurricane!
Taaaaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: Sure thing! It'll be done in no time!

text_block_list.name: Female Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
You're a lifesaver!
We've got extra-hungry students today.
With this, we should be all set!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now's the time! Pegasus Burning!
Don't give up! Rise to your feet!

text_block_list.name: Dejected Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You guys...! Thank you.
Things haven't been going well lately,
but I'll give it one more shot!

...After that, I kept helping Biko Pegasus,
and—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, that wraps up today's patrol!
...Hehehe~♪
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a great mood.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Thanks to you, Trainer,
we protected way more peace across the
academy today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Plus, something awesome happened!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Feast your eyes
—on the 'Carotene Power! Carrot Lassi'!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's my absolute favorite!
It's always sold out in a flash,
but there was magically one left today!
choice_data_list: Must be your reward for working so...
That must be a reward for all your...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you think so...?
All right then, chee—

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat...?! The Carrot Lassi
is sold out again already...?

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I started drinking those,
I've been doing so well in races...
Wh-What do I do?
Tomorrow's race is ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ! ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, upperclassman! If you want,
you can have my Carrot Lassi!

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?! N-No, I couldn't!
I mean, that's yours...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me!
You've got a race tomorrow, right?
Drink this and give it everything you've
got!

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thank you, I won't forget this!
I'm definitely gonna win tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that?!
She looked so happy!

Still...
she had been looking forward to that so much.
Is she really okay?
While I was worrying over her...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry about me!
There are plenty of other drinks I wanna
try!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... Hmmm...
Ah, hahaha!
There are so many to choose from!
choice_data_list: In that case, let me buy you whate...
How about I treat you to whatever you—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thanks! But I'm good!
A true hero never relies on handouts!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heroes are supposed to save others,
after all!
Whining or being selfish is completely
un-heroic, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that upperclassman smile is the
greatest reward I could ask for!
That's more than enough for Justice Biko!

Step by step,
she was becoming the hero she always dreamed
of. ...Even so,
I still found myself wanting to support her
in any way I could.
